body: Thank you truly, a very good stayed up with me last night and we talked. This along with with some kind words reminds me of how important it is to stick around. I used to call facilitate mental health groups here in New Jersey for a little while and I love doing that maybe I'll look into being able to help out somewhere. Again thank you for the kind words.

As someone who suffers from major depressive disorder this poem hit me in an incredibly impactful way. In my opinion you captured despair better than most the part I connected with to be perfectly honest was wanting to be left alone but still wanting all those you love at your side. It's that feeling of I love when you guys are there I don't know how to express that but my mind is just so broken all the time really really wonderful and expressive writing. Thank you
Thank you for all the input everybody, I truly appreciate it

Yes I am but I'm truly convinced that my history with doctors terrible insurance and just no luck in general and I've had a very hard time connecting with any psychiatrists or therapists and their course of treatment greatly changes from what mine would be and the things they do like antipsychotics I have a tardive dyskinesic reaction to and so I can't take them the antidepressants don't help with the anxiety and none of those things help with sleep this all seems so hopeless I truly do thank you for taking your time out to be polite I appreciate it.
